questions.explanation: Luke writes: "every man heard them speak in his own tongue."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what was made manifest to the world on the day of Pentecost?
choices: The Law of the new covenant
The temple of the Spirit
The Church
The kingdom of David
questions.explanation: Catechism 1076 says: "The Church was made manifest to the world on the day of Pentecost by the outpouring of the Holy Spirit."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, in about which year could St. Paul already write to the Corinthians of the Resurrection?
questions.explanation: Catechism 639 says: "In about A.D. 56 St. Paul could already write to the Corinthians" that Christ was raised on the third day in accordance with the scriptures.

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, Christ's Resurrection was a return to earthly life, like the raising of Lazarus.
questions.explanation: Catechism 646 says: "Christ's Resurrection was not a return to earthly life, as was the case with the raisings from the dead that he had performed before Easter."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, the Gospels describe the moment of Christ's Resurrection in detail.
questions.explanation: Catechism 647 says: "no one was an eyewitness to Christ's Resurrection and no evangelist describes it."

questions.prompt: According to St. Paul, what follows if Christ be not risen again?
choices: Our sins are forgiven only in part
Our hope is delayed until the last day
Our preaching is vain, and our faith is also vain
Our baptism is not valid
questions.correctAnswer: Our preaching is vain, and our faith is also vain
questions.explanation: Paul writes: "if Christ be not risen again, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain."

questions.prompt: The Catechism says the Resurrection above all constitutes the confirmation of all Christ's works and ____.
questions.explanation: Catechism 651 says: "The Resurrection above all constitutes the confirmation of all Christ's works and teachings."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does Christ do by his death, and what by his Resurrection?
choices: By his death he judges the world; by his Resurrection he saves it
By his death he liberates us from sin; by his Resurrection he opens the way to a new life
By his death he fulfills the Law; by his Resurrection he sends the Spirit
By his death he reveals the Father; by his Resurrection he founds the Church
questions.correctAnswer: By his death he liberates us from sin; by his Resurrection he opens the way to a new life
questions.explanation: Catechism 654 says: "by his death, Christ liberates us from sin; by his Resurrection, he opens for us the way to a new life."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, the risen Christ is the principle and source of what?
choices: Our daily bread
Our natural reason
Our future resurrection
Our earthly kingdom
questions.explanation: Catechism 655 says the risen Christ "is the principle and source of our future resurrection."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what do the empty tomb and the linen cloths signify in themselves?
choices: That the body had been taken away by the disciples
That by God's power Christ's body had escaped the bonds of death and corruption
That the burial had been left unfinished
That the guards had been overcome by sleep
questions.correctAnswer: That by God's power Christ's body had escaped the bonds of death and corruption
questions.explanation: Catechism 657 says: "The empty tomb and the linen cloths lying there signify in themselves that by God's power Christ's body had escaped the bonds of death and corruption."

questions.prompt: According to 1 Corinthians 15:3-4, what did Paul deliver first of all, which he also received?
choices: That Christ died for our sins, was buried, and rose again the third day, according to the scriptures
That Christ suffered under Pilate, and ascended into heaven
That Christ was born of a virgin, and taught in the temple
That Christ founded a Church on Peter, and sent the Twelve
questions.correctAnswer: That Christ died for our sins, was buried, and rose again the third day, according to the scriptures
questions.explanation: Paul writes: "how that Christ died for our sins, according to the scriptures: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day, according to the scriptures."

questions.prompt: According to 1 Corinthians 15:6, to how many brethren at once was the risen Lord seen?
choices: The eleven
Seventy-two
More than five hundred
More than a thousand
questions.explanation: Paul writes that "he was seen by more than five hundred brethren at once: of whom many remain until this present, and some are fallen asleep."

questions.prompt: What does the Lord say to his disciples in John 20:21?
choices: Feed my sheep, and strengthen thy brethren
As the Father hath sent me, I also send you
Go ye into all the world and preach the gospel
Behold, I am with you all days
questions.correctAnswer: As the Father hath sent me, I also send you
questions.explanation: Jesus says: "Peace be to you. As the Father hath sent me, I also send you."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, on the evening of Easter Jesus breathed on his apostles and said what?
choices: Go and make disciples
Do this in memory of me
Peace I leave with you
Receive the Holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Catechism 1485 says that on the evening of the first day of the week Jesus "breathed on them, and said to them: 'Receive the Holy Spirit.'"

questions.prompt: True or False: According to Luke 24:34, the disciples said: The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
questions.explanation: Luke writes that they were "saying: The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what do the apostles remain, as witnesses of the Risen One?
choices: The teachers of the Law
The foundation stones of his Church
The judges of the twelve tribes
The keepers of the temple
questions.correctAnswer: The foundation stones of his Church
questions.explanation: Catechism 642 says: "As witnesses of the Risen One, they remain the foundation stones of his Church."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to John 20:19, the disciples were gathered with the doors shut for fear of the Jews when Jesus came and stood in their midst.
questions.explanation: John writes: "the doors were shut, where the disciples were gathered together, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them: Peace be to you."

questions.prompt: According to John 20:25, what did Thomas say he would need in order to believe?
choices: To touch the hem of his garment
To see him break bread with the disciples
To hear him speak the words of the Scriptures again
To see in his hands the print of the nails, and put his finger and hand in his side
questions.correctAnswer: To see in his hands the print of the nails, and put his finger and hand in his side
questions.explanation: Thomas said: "Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the place of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe."

questions.prompt: According to Luke 24:39, what does Jesus say a spirit hath not?
choices: Flesh and bones
Voice and breath
Wounds and scars
Hands and feet
questions.explanation: Jesus says: "handle, and see: for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as you see me to have."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does the risen body of Jesus still bear?
choices: The garments of the burial
The traces of his Passion
The crown of thorns
The glory of Mount Tabor
questions.explanation: Catechism 645 says the risen body "is the same body that had been tortured and crucified, for it still bears the traces of his Passion."

questions.prompt: Which of these persons does the Catechism name among those Jesus raised before Easter?
choices: Tabitha
Dorcas
Eutychus
Jairus' daughter
questions.explanation: Catechism 646 says the raisings Jesus performed before Easter were Jairus' daughter, the young man of Naim, and Lazarus.

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, Christ was raised with a different body, and returned to an earthly life.
questions.explanation: Catechism 999 says: "Christ is raised with his own body... but he did not return to an earthly life."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what will God grant to our bodies by reuniting them with our souls?
choices: Incorruptible life
Perfect rest
Earthly honor
Spiritual knowledge
questions.explanation: Catechism 997 says: "God, in his almighty power, will definitively grant incorruptible life to our bodies by reuniting them with our souls, through the power of Jesus' Resurrection."

questions.prompt: St. Paul writes: "O death, where is thy ____? O death, where is thy sting?"
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:55 reads: "O death, where is thy victory? O death, where is thy sting?"

questions.prompt: St. Paul writes: "Christ is risen from the dead, the ____ of them that sleep."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:20 reads: "Christ is risen from the dead, the firstfruits of them that sleep."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does our participation in the Eucharist already give us a foretaste of?
choices: The vision of the angels
The glory of the temple
The peace of the saints
Christ's transfiguration of our bodies
questions.explanation: Catechism 1000 says: "our participation in the Eucharist already gives us a foretaste of Christ's transfiguration of our bodies."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, on which day of the week did Jesus rise from the dead?
choices: The day of the sabbath
The first day of the week
The day of preparation
The seventh day of the week
questions.correctAnswer: The first day of the week
questions.explanation: Catechism 2174 says: "Jesus rose from the dead 'on the first day of the week.'"

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does Sunday as the eighth day symbolize?
choices: The end of the old covenant
The rest of the sabbath after the labors of the week
The return of the people to the land
The new creation ushered in by Christ's Resurrection
questions.correctAnswer: The new creation ushered in by Christ's Resurrection
questions.explanation: Catechism 2174 says that because it is the eighth day following the sabbath, it "symbolizes the new creation ushered in by Christ's Resurrection."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does the Church call the day of Christ's Resurrection, on which she celebrates the Paschal mystery every seventh day?
choices: The Lord's Day, or Sunday
The day of the sun alone
The day of preparation
The Great Sabbath
questions.explanation: Catechism 1166 says the Church celebrates the Paschal mystery every seventh day, "which day is appropriately called the Lord's Day or Sunday."

questions.prompt: The Catechism says Easter is the "Feast of feasts," the "Solemnity of ____."
questions.explanation: Catechism 1169 says Easter is "the 'Feast of feasts,' the 'Solemnity of solemnities.'"

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what is at the heart of the Church's life?
choices: The Sunday celebration of the Lord's Day and his Eucharist
The daily recitation of the Psalms
The yearly celebration of the great feasts
The weekly observance of fasting
questions.correctAnswer: The Sunday celebration of the Lord's Day and his Eucharist
questions.explanation: Catechism 2177 says: "The Sunday celebration of the Lord's Day and his Eucharist is at the heart of the Church's life."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, Sunday is the pre-eminent day for the liturgical assembly.
questions.explanation: Catechism 1167 says: "Sunday is the pre-eminent day for the liturgical assembly."

questions.prompt: The Catechism says the Exsultet of the Easter Vigil sings: "O truly blessed ____."
questions.explanation: Catechism 647 says: "O truly blessed Night, sings the Exsultet of the Easter Vigil."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does St. Athanasius call Easter?
choices: The Great Passover
The Great Sunday
The Great Joy
The Great Light
questions.explanation: Catechism 1169 says: "St. Athanasius calls Easter 'the Great Sunday.'"

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, which three sacraments are the sacraments of Christian initiation?
choices: Baptism, Confirmation, and the Eucharist
Baptism, Anointing of the Sick, and Confirmation
Baptism, Penance, and Matrimony
Confirmation, Holy Orders, and the Eucharist
questions.explanation: Catechism 1212 says: "The sacraments of Christian initiation - Baptism, Confirmation, and the Eucharist - lay the foundations of every Christian life."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, from what day has the Church celebrated and administered holy Baptism?
choices: The day of Easter
The day of Pentecost
The day of the Ascension
The day of the Transfiguration
questions.explanation: Catechism 1226 says: "From the very day of Pentecost the Church has celebrated and administered holy Baptism."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does the white garment symbolize?
choices: That the person baptized has put on Christ and risen with him
That the person baptized has been sealed for the day of judgment
That the person baptized has been purified by fire
That the person baptized has joined the choir of angels
questions.correctAnswer: That the person baptized has put on Christ and risen with him
questions.explanation: Catechism 1243 says: "The white garment symbolizes that the person baptized has 'put on Christ,' has risen with Christ."

questions.prompt: St. Paul writes: "we are buried together with him by baptism into death; that as Christ is risen from the dead by the glory of the Father, so we also may walk in ____ of life."
questions.explanation: Romans 6:4 reads: "so we also may walk in newness of life."

questions.prompt: In Matthew 28:19, in whose name does Jesus command that the nations be baptized?
choices: The Holy Trinity, one in glory and power
The living God, who made heaven and earth
The Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost
The Lord Jesus Christ, who died and rose again
questions.correctAnswer: The Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost
questions.explanation: Jesus says: "Going therefore, teach ye all nations; baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost."

questions.prompt: According to Acts 2:38, what does Peter tell the crowd to do?
choices: Wait for the promise of the Father in Jerusalem
Keep the law of Moses and be circumcised
Go up to the temple and make an offering for sin
Do penance, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Do penance, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ
questions.explanation: Peter said: "Do penance, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ, for the remission of your sins: and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, the candle of the baptized is lit from the sanctuary lamp.
questions.explanation: Catechism 1243 says the candle is "lit from the Easter candle."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, which sacrament strengthens the faithful, who are born anew by Baptism?
choices: Confirmation
Penance
Matrimony
Anointing of the Sick
questions.explanation: Catechism 1212 says the faithful "are born anew by Baptism, strengthened by the sacrament of Confirmation, and receive in the Eucharist the food of eternal life."

questions.prompt: What received Jesus out of the apostles' sight at the Ascension, according to Acts 1:9?
choices: A whirlwind
A light from above
A chariot of fire
A cloud
questions.explanation: Luke writes: "while they looked on, he was raised up: and a cloud received him out of their sight."

questions.prompt: Mark writes that the Lord Jesus was taken up into heaven, and "sitteth on the right hand of ____."
questions.explanation: Mark 16:19 reads: "the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven, and sitteth on the right hand of God."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does Christ permanently exercise in heaven?
choices: His office as prophet
His rule over the angels alone
His priesthood
His kingship over Israel
questions.explanation: Catechism 662 says: "There Christ permanently exercises his priesthood," for he "always lives to make intercession."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, how many weeks of Easter come to an end at Pentecost?
choices: Five
Twelve
Forty
Seven
questions.explanation: Catechism 731 says: "On the day of Pentecost when the seven weeks of Easter had come to an end, Christ's Passover is fulfilled in the outpouring of the Holy Spirit."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, on the day of Pentecost the Holy Trinity is fully revealed.
questions.explanation: Catechism 732 says: "On that day, the Holy Trinity is fully revealed."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does fire symbolize in the Holy Spirit's actions?
choices: The transforming energy of the Spirit's actions
The presence of God in the temple
The zeal of the prophets for the Law
The judgment of the wicked on the last day
questions.correctAnswer: The transforming energy of the Spirit's actions
questions.explanation: Catechism 696 says: "fire symbolizes the transforming energy of the Holy Spirit's actions."

questions.prompt: According to Acts 1:8, where will the apostles be witnesses, after the Holy Ghost comes upon them?
choices: In Rome, and in Athens, and in all Asia
In Galilee, and in the temple, and before the council
In Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost part of the earth
In the synagogues of Israel, and among the exiles
questions.correctAnswer: In Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost part of the earth
questions.explanation: Jesus says: "you shall be witnesses unto me in Jerusalem, and in all Judea, and Samaria, and even to the uttermost part of the earth."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to Acts 2:4, they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with divers tongues.
questions.explanation: Luke writes: "they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they began to speak with divers tongues, according as the Holy Ghost gave them to speak."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does the symbolism of water signify?
choices: The Holy Spirit's presence in the temple
The Holy Spirit's judgment of the world
The Holy Spirit's gift of wisdom
The Holy Spirit's action in Baptism
questions.correctAnswer: The Holy Spirit's action in Baptism
questions.explanation: Catechism 694 says: "the symbolism of water signifies the Holy Spirit's action in Baptism."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, anointing with oil is the sacramental sign of which sacrament, in Christian initiation?
choices: Holy Orders
Baptism
Anointing of the Sick
Confirmation
questions.explanation: Catechism 695 says: "In Christian initiation, anointing is the sacramental sign of Confirmation, called 'chrismation' in the Churches of the East."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, what does the Hebrew word Christ mean?
choices: The one born of the Virgin
The one raised from the dead
The one sent from heaven
The one anointed by God's Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: The one anointed by God's Spirit
questions.explanation: Catechism 695 says: "Christ (in Hebrew 'messiah') means the one 'anointed' by God's Spirit."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, the cloud and light occur together in the manifestations of the Holy Spirit.
questions.explanation: Catechism 697 says: "Cloud and light. These two images occur together in the manifestations of the Holy Spirit."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, the symbol of the seal is close to which other symbol?
choices: Water
Anointing
Fire
The dove
questions.explanation: Catechism 698 says: "The seal is a symbol close to that of anointing."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, by what is the Holy Spirit given, as the hand symbolizes?
choices: The breaking of bread
The sprinkling of water
The reading of the Law
The Apostles' imposition of hands
questions.explanation: Catechism 699 says: "it is by the Apostles' imposition of hands that the Holy Spirit is given."

questions.prompt: According to the Catechism, in what form does the Holy Spirit come down upon Christ when he comes up from the water of his baptism?
choices: A flame
A star
A dove
A cloud
questions.explanation: Catechism 701 says: "When Christ comes up from the water of his baptism, the Holy Spirit, in the form of a dove, comes down upon him and remains with him."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to the Catechism, the Holy Spirit is the Paraclete, literally he who is called to one's side.
questions.explanation: Catechism 692 says Jesus calls the Holy Spirit the Paraclete, "literally, 'he who is called to one's side.'"

questions.prompt: In Acts 6:5, who was the first of the seven chosen by the multitude?
choices: Stephen
Timon
Philip
Nicanor
questions.explanation: Luke writes: "they chose Stephen, a man full of faith, and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas."

questions.prompt: What does Stephen say as he is stoned, in Acts 7:58?
choices: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit
I commend my spirit to thee
Remember me, O Lord
Father, forgive them
questions.explanation: Luke writes: "they stoned Stephen, invoking, and saying: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."

questions.prompt: What does the Lord say of Saul to Ananias, in Acts 9:15?
choices: He is a vessel of election, to carry my name before the Gentiles
He is a servant of the law, to be corrected by the elders
He is a man of zeal, to teach the sons of Israel
He is a witness of the cross, to be sent to Rome
questions.correctAnswer: He is a vessel of election, to carry my name before the Gentiles
questions.explanation: The Lord said: "this man is to me a vessel of election, to carry my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel."

questions.prompt: According to Acts 14:21, through what must we enter into the kingdom of God?
choices: Many prayers
Many tribulations
Many works
Many sacrifices
questions.explanation: Luke writes that Paul and Barnabas were "exhorting them to continue in the faith: and that through many tribulations we must enter into the kingdom of God."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to Acts 12:5, while Peter was kept in prison, prayer was made without ceasing by the church unto God for him.
questions.explanation: Luke writes: "Peter therefore was kept in prison. But prayer was made without ceasing by the church unto God for him."

questions.prompt: According to Acts 13:2, whom did the Holy Ghost ask the Church to separate for the work?
choices: Philip and Stephen
Paul and Silas
Saul and Barnabas
Peter and John
questions.explanation: Luke writes: "the Holy Ghost said to them: Separate me Saul and Barnabas, for the work whereunto I have taken them."

questions.prompt: According to Acts 16:9, where did the man in Paul's vision beg him to come?
choices: Athens
Macedonia
Rome
Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Luke writes: "a man of Macedonia standing and beseeching him, and saying: Pass over into Macedonia, and help us."

questions.prompt: True or False: According to Acts 28:30, Paul remained two whole years in the public prison at Rome.
questions.explanation: Luke writes: "he remained two whole years in his own hired lodging."
